This is a typescript summary headed « Résumé de quelques résultats de Kostant (sous groupes simples de rang 1). » It concerns a semisimple group over a characteristic-zero field and its Lie algebra.

Theorem 1(i) lists a), b), cancelled b′), c), c′), d), then states existence of i with Lie(i)(1)=x, semisimplicity of x and uniqueness of f. These claims were read; the theorem as a whole was not proved or externally checked.

Part (ii) states existence of an Sl(2,k) homomorphism for nilpotent e, adds a uniqueness assertion in terms of x or i, and asserts conjugacy. Its final parenthesis is unfinished at this page boundary.

The English bibliographical note contains Oct.1959. This is a cited publication date, not a date of composition. The lower-left 15 is archive foliation and is retained only as a comment, not as an author page number.

No source diagram, geometric drawing, stamp, or letterhead is present. The pen enclosures are insertion/cancellation connectors. The TikZ in reading.tex preserves the relative placement of raised text.

There is no explicit written expression such as « peut-être » or a question on this page. Hesitation/revision is visible through the cancelled b′), erased words, repeated typing, and insertions. Apparatus question marks are editorial uncertainty, not quotations from the source.
The page itself has « propre de » followed by blank paper. No operator has been supplied.
Mathematical tensions prompted attention to the actual minus in g(-2) and the actual equality in e=0. Both are preserved. The detached slash occurs beside i.e., not across that equality.

H uses a bold heading macro for Théorème; this was treated as a presentation wrapper, not counted separately as an ink difference. The source heading is underlined. Missing handwritten wrappers alone are likewise excluded from the difference list.
